purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/service routes, bounded anonymous access review, scope limits, and uncertainty for Eldoret.
assessment: The official Kenya land-registry directory identifies Eldoret Ardhi House in Uasin Gishu. The official City of Eldoret portal exposes property valuation and land-rates procedures. Anonymous GET metadata was obtained for Eldoret-specific public ArcGIS land-use and boundary/roads services, but neither is cadastral parcel data. A generic public Parcels_v service was inspected and rejected because its full extent is Nairobi. No safe Eldoret parcel ID+geometry response was verified and no GeoJSON sample is retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry custodian/procedure context is evidenced, but a city-bounded open cadastral response is not. registryFound remains null.
safeFieldAllowlist: safe parcel or feature identifier only if publicly exposed and non-personal

queries.query: Eldoret Kenya official cadastral parcel GIS map county land registry
queries.outcome: Official city portal, State Department for Lands registry directory, eProcedures Eldoret contact page, Ardhisasa, and Eldoret-related ArcGIS services found; no public anonymous Eldoret parcel vector response verified.

queries.query: Eldoret Kenya ramani ya ardhi kadastri viwanja huduma rasmi
queries.outcome: Official Swahili Kenya Lands service-charter material found; it describes land registration, survey/mapping and plot services but no public Eldoret parcel endpoint.

attempts.result: Official City of Eldoret portal loaded; service links cover land rates/property charges and property valuation, with no parcel API exposed in the fetched page.
Official registry directory identifies Eldoret Ardhi House and land registration, administration, valuation, survey and mapping functions.

Official eProcedures contact page identifies Ministry of Lands and Physical Planning - Eldoret at Ardhi House, Oloo Street, and lists registrar, valuer, consent and rates counters; no open parcel geometry endpoint.
National Ardhisasa application shell loaded anonymously. No login or credentials were used; no safe parcel query/schema/geometry endpoint was obtained.
Metadata returned Web Mercator polygon layer Land Use 2020; thematic land-use data, not cadastral parcel data. No parcel query was attempted.
Metadata returned EldoretCityBoundary polygon and Roads_prj polyline layers; no parcel layer.

Generic Parcels_v metadata returned parcel-like layer parcels_e with EPSG:4326, but full extent is Nairobi (36.8080967–36.8261209E, -1.2775184–-1.2638381N), not Eldoret; excluded as false positive and no query/sample retained.

Local curl TLS verification failed because the host presented a self-signed certificate chain. No TLS verification bypass was used; the same official page was independently observed through web discovery/open results.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No exact-point parcel containment test was completed. The exact WUP point [0.524205333339166, 35.2660146100744] was preserved and not shifted; the rejected Nairobi service and non-cadastral Eldoret layers are not evidence of citywide absence.

remainingUncertainty: The current Ardhisasa JavaScript/configuration, any authenticated or restricted Eldoret cadastral service, native parcel identity, parcel CRS, exact-point parcel, and citywide open coverage remain unverified. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
runtimeAssessment: held; serial reviewer must independently qualify any adapter
